 MISSOULA, Mont. — Two products are being recalled due to safety hazards that could put children and infants at risk, according to the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission.
 The recalls, announced Nov. 5, involve more than 10,000 children's slide playsets and approximately 19,600 nursing pillows.
 Arlopu slide playsets 
 Arlopu is recalling about 10,318 slide playsets because openings can trap a child's head or neck, posing a risk of serious injury or death.
 On model KT-CS17, the basketball net can also become unhooked, creating an entanglement or strangulation hazard.
 The playsets were sold on Amazon and Walmart.com from April 2023 through August 2026 for $90 to $130.
 The affected models include KT-CS17 and LY-31. The model number for KT-CS17 is printed under the elevated platform, while LY-31 is printed on the upper back panel behind the slide.
 One entrapment incident resulting in abrasions to a child's neck has been reported.
 Consumers should stop using the playsets immediately and store them away from children.
 Arlopu is offering free repair kits with redesigned panels, basketball hoops and instructions. Consumers can contact the company at 800-657-9218 or arlopu_support@163.com.
 X-VESOLJE nursing pillows 
 Kikea Store is recalling about 19,596 X-VESOLJE nursing pillows because they can block an infant's breathing and pose a suffocation hazard.
 The C-shaped pillows, model NP001, were sold on Amazon from April 2025 through June 2026 for $24 to $34.
 The pillows were available in three designs: white with a leaf pattern, dark brown with multicolored feathers and a multicolored puzzle-piece pattern.
 No injuries have been reported.
 Consumers should stop using the pillows immediately and contact Kikea Store at zsally929@gmail.com for a full refund.
 After confirming the product with the company, customers will be instructed to cut the pillow in half, email a photo of the destroyed product and dispose of it.
